notes.title: The UMI PLUSHIE is HERE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone, thank you for your patience ₍ᐢ. .ᐢ₎ ₊˚⊹♡ The final design for the plushie is here, and the campaign is now live![/h3]

[h3][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/umi-plush]https://www.makeship.com/products/umi-plush[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Rental Short Story Contest
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! We're happy to announce a new contest, where you can write a short stories about Rental![/h1]

[b]The rules are as follows :[/b]

The short stories may be a maximum of a 100 words, inspired by a writing contest that is held in our city in Chile

You can use the characters or the world of Rental, feel free to do what you want as long it is in the world of Rental and follows the rules.

We'll have 2 winners, one will be voted among the devs, the other will be chosen by popular vote on the discord server. Each winner will get a 15.000CLP/15USD STEAM giftcard as a prize.

No NSFW. No outright gore. No AI generated content.

Send your submissions through the forum Short Story channel on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ytcsw3A6td]discord server.[/url] 

Submissions that don't follow the rules will be deleted, be mindful of what you upload.

Deadline is 27 of may 23:59, Chilean time (20:59 PST). 

Have fun! (ᴗ͈ˬᴗ͈)ꕤ.ﾟWe can't wait to see what you come up with✶⋆.˚꩜ .ᐟ˙⋆✶!

notes.title: We've reached 1000 reviews!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879394/6c7aa8c22a10c45de6eeef81dc7862dfad7ce91b.png[/img]

[b]Thank you so much everyone![/b] ִֶָ𓂃 ࣪˖ ִֶָ🐇་༘࿐ We're working hard on delivering new and bigger projects, hope you can keep supporting us!

We've also just updated the game with the following fixes:
[list]
[*] Traditional and Simplified Chinese added to the game's languages.
[*] Fixed bug where achievement "Short-Term Rental" was earned even though game was finished in more than 10 minutes.
[*] Moved a particularly hard to see item needed for the "Curious Bunny" achievement.
[*] Moved the evil couch to avoid bunnies from being trapped.
[/list]
